stories.title: Trump, 3 medya kuruluşunun Beyaz Saray’a girişini yasakladı

en.title: Trump bans 3 media outlets from White House access
en.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that CNN, MS NOW, and Politico have been prohibited from accessing the White House. Trump cited the outlets' reporting as his reason for the decision.

stories.title: Güllü soruşturmasında yeni gelişme! Komşusu ATV Haber'e konuştu: "Bu olay tamamen planlı gerçekleşmiş ölüm"

en.title: New development in Güllü investigation as neighbor speaks to ATV News
en.summary: A new development emerged in the case of singer Güllü, who died after falling from a window at her home in Yalova. A neighbor discussed details of the incident with ATV News.

stories.title: Trump'tan CNN, MS NOW ve Politico'ya Beyaz Saray yasağı

en.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House
en.summary: US President Donald Trump prohibited CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from accessing the White House, claiming the outlets published false news about him and his administration.

en.title: Building under demolition collapses in Küçükçekmece
en.summary: A six-story building that was undergoing demolition collapsed in the İnönü neighborhood of Küçükçekmece. Emergency services responded to the scene following reports of the incident.

stories.title: AFAD duyurdu: Kuşadası Körfezi'nde 3,8 büyüklüğünde deprem

en.title: AFAD announces: 3.8 magnitude earthquake in Kuşadası Gulf
en.summary: A 3.8 magnitude earthquake occurred off the Kuşadası Gulf in the Aegean Sea.

stories.title: Küçükçekmece'de bina yıkım esnasında çöktü: Yoldan geçen 2 kişi yaralandı

en.title: Building collapsed during demolition in Küçükçekmece: 2 people injured
en.summary: A building undergoing urban redevelopment demolition collapsed in Istanbul, injuring two pedestrians on the street.

stories.title: Girne’deki gemi kazasında WhatsApp yazışmaları ortaya çıktı: Yolcuları bile bile ölüme göndermişler

en.title: WhatsApp messages emerge in Girne ship accident: Passengers sent to death knowingly
en.summary: An investigation into a passenger ship that sank near Girne revealed WhatsApp communications related to repairs attempted on a broken section of the vessel.

stories.title: Özgür Özel Bursa’da binlerle buluştu, Erdoğan'a seslendi 'Gel Bursa’da seçimleri yenileyelim'

en.title: Özgür Özel met with thousands in Bursa, called out to Erdoğan 'Come to Bursa, let's hold elections again'
en.summary: YENİ Party leader Özgür Özel addressed supporters in Bursa, stating the party welcomes all democrats opposed to autocracy and single-person rule.

stories.title: Küçükçekmece'de yıkımı süren bina çöktü! 2 yaralı var

en.title: Building under demolition collapses in Küçükçekmece! 2 injured
en.summary: A building being demolished as part of urban renewal in Küçükçekmece collapsed, with the remaining structure giving way. Two people were injured and taken to hospital.

en.title: AFAD announced: 3.8 magnitude earthquake in Aydın
en.summary: A 3.8 magnitude earthquake occurred in the Aegean Sea near Kuşadası, Aydın at 21:09 according to AFAD's announcement.

stories.title: Küçükçekmece'de akran vahşeti: 16 yaşındaki Yusuf satırlarla katledilmişti! O canilerin cezası belli oldu...

en.title: Peer violence in Küçükçekmece: 16-year-old Yusuf was killed with cleavers! The sentence for those criminals has been determined
en.summary: A 16-year-old boy was killed by acquaintances in Küçükçekmece after refusing to repair a motorcycle. The court has handed down sentences in the case.

stories.title: Girne açıklarındaki gemi kazasında yeni gelişme: Kırık kızak soruşturmanın odağında! 7 gün ek tutuklama

en.title: New development in ship accident off Girne: Broken slip at center of investigation! 7 days additional detention
en.summary: In the investigation of a ship accident off Girne in northern Cyprus, the detention of nine suspects has been extended for an additional week.

stories.title: Trump açıkladı: Danimarka ve Grönland ile anlaştık

en.title: Trump announced: We reached a deal with Denmark and Greenland
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced that the United States has reached an agreement with Denmark and Greenland.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında 2 kişi için tutuklama talebi

en.title: Arrest warrant sought for 2 people in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: Prosecutors requested detention orders for two of four suspects held in connection with the death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu.

stories.title: Trump’tan 3 medya kuruluşuna Beyaz Saray yasağı

en.title: Trump bars 3 media outlets from White House
en.summary: President Donald Trump announced he has revoked White House access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, citing false reporting.

en.title: Supplementary indictment filed in İmamoğlu investigation
en.summary: Prosecutors filed an additional indictment seeking prison sentences for 29 suspects including Ekrem İmamoğlu, Fatih Keleş, and Ali Sukas.

stories.title: New York borsası karışık seyirle kapandı

en.title: New York stock exchange closes with mixed trading
en.summary: The New York stock exchange finished the final trading day of the week with mixed results, with the Dow Jones index declining 0.18 percent to 51,682.64 points.
